2026-07-31.title: Canonical backend foundation
2026-07-31.detail: Created the initial FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, and pgvector structure; established raw ingestion, case retrieval, semantic retrieval, metadata filters, and status/hash integrity rules.

2026-07-31.title: Initial corpus/retrieval tooling
2026-07-31.detail: Added A2AJ Parquet ingestion, curated immigration selection, chunk storage, grouped passage retrieval, retrieval evaluation fixtures, and staged Federal Court collection/import tooling.

2026-07-31.title: Early citation graph
2026-07-31.detail: Added citations, citation metrics, A2AJ provenance/mapping, and the initial interactive prototype/citation-map capability.

2026-08-01.title: Resumable enrichment operations
2026-08-01.detail: Established lock-protected overnight orchestration with per-job logs, atomic state, preflight, resume behavior, tagging, chunking, citation extraction, local embeddings, and reference-library verification.

2026-08-01.title: Legal taxonomy and reference corpus
2026-08-01.detail: Added evidence-bearing `ca_legal_v2` tagging and a separate checksum-validated reference-library workflow.

2026-08-02.title: Direct Federal Court ingestion
2026-08-02.detail: Added A2AJ-driven Federal Court item retrieval, canonical item URL normalization, and metadata-preserving SQLite PDF staging upgrades.

2026-08-02.title: Roadmap and quality planning
2026-08-02.detail: Captured the staged product roadmap for citation intelligence, research workflows, quality gates, performance baselines, and eventual grounded research answers.

2026-08-03.title: Citation analytics expansion
2026-08-03.detail: Added surprise feeds, doctrine shifts, hidden bridge paths, inheritance chains, missing-authority detection, lifecycle tracking, cross-court flow, position profiles, completion suggestions, issue dashboards, and associated CSV exports.

2026-08-03.title: Case reader and issue workbench
2026-08-03.detail: Added the standalone case reader, name-first citation labels, issue/statute/legal-area graph workbench, common-citer comparison, and chunk-backed citation context capability.

2026-08-03.title: Source and provenance hardening
2026-08-03.detail: Established the separate reference-library manifest/checksum workflow and clarified source staging versus canonical case data.

2026-08-05.title: FC citation rebuild toolkit
2026-08-05.detail: Added seed normalization, seed-to-local mapping, gold templates, evidence extraction, and extractor evaluation for Federal Court citation work.

2026-08-05.title: Dual text segmentation
2026-08-05.detail: Added section and paragraph chunk sets with labels and paragraph bounds, allowing reader context and extraction work to use more structured segments than fixed-size chunks.

2026-08-05.title: FC metadata reliability
2026-08-05.detail: Added consensus metadata confidence, source evidence, quality flags, audit, gold-set, backfill, and optional adjudication workflows.

2026-08-07.title: Five-layer processing contract
2026-08-07.detail: Made metadata, overall chunks, heading chunks, case citations, and statutes explicit deterministic stages with separately callable behavior.

2026-08-07.title: Citation Pass QA
2026-08-07.detail: Added stored-versus-live case citation, statute, and metadata comparison with source offsets, resolution state, and color-separated evidence layers.

2026-08-07.title: Generated-page reliability safeguards
2026-08-07.detail: Repaired Python-to-JavaScript escaping failures and documented raw-string/double-escape requirements for inline regular expressions and strings.

2026-08-10.title: Nested IRPA/IRPR provision support
2026-08-10.detail: Added deterministic recognition for forms such as `paragraph 34(1)(f) of IRPA`, `IRPA paragraph 34(1)(f)`, and `34(1)(f) of IRPA`.

2026-08-10.title: Repository/documentation consolidation
2026-08-10.detail: Established explicit active-versus-legacy folders and documentation authority rules for citation stabilization work.

2026-08-12.title: Advanced Data Explorer
2026-08-12.detail: Promoted `/data-explorer` into the research-facing UI with advanced filters, minister selection, outcome/judge/court/year controls, sort modes, and stored-citation decision reading.

2026-08-12.title: Local target resolution
2026-08-12.detail: Added batch local resolution for full and short citations, then completed a large stored-citation linkage pass.

2026-08-12.title: Isolated LotD import
2026-08-12.detail: Added the separate Luck of the Draw III import/export workflow in its own PostgreSQL schema, outside canonical case tables.

2026-08-13.title: Full-corpus intelligence correction
2026-08-13.detail: Changed citation-map behavior to use the full corpus by default, with master-300 focus mode only when explicitly enabled.

2026-08-13.title: Live inventory and active-interface cleanup
2026-08-13.detail: Added database-backed About statistics, full-corpus citation-intelligence/case-reader search behavior, and visible legacy/test labels for non-primary pages.

2026-08-17.title: Six-tab interface recovery
2026-08-17.detail: Recovered the active one-page research shell after an interruption and revalidated the primary tabs, route availability, and data-backed page behavior.

2026-08-18.title: Unified active research experience
2026-08-18.detail: Aligned Data Explorer and Case Reader with the iLIT research visual language and restored the supporting case-list API.

2026-08-18.title: Search and refresh reliability
2026-08-18.detail: Changed active Case Search to title/citation-first matching unless full text is explicitly requested, and hardened local Uvicorn/cloudflared restart behavior.

2026-08-19.title: Docket field and linkage
2026-08-19.detail: Added canonical `docket_number`, backfilled it across the corpus, and correlated eligible docket values with Federal Court activity records.

2026-08-19.title: FC activity classification
2026-08-19.detail: Added the separate activity case, document, and classification layer with deterministic normalization, classification scripts, sample outputs, and tests.

2026-08-20.title: Activity-derived intelligence
2026-08-20.detail: Expanded rule-based Federal Court activity classification, batch processing, reviewable sample outputs, and gold-template workflows.

2026-08-21.title: Case type/issue/challenge derivation
2026-08-21.detail: Designed and extended derived intelligence using early decision text, citation/statute signals, tags, and activity documents as evidence inputs.

2026-09-01.title: Inline decision-reader usability
2026-09-01.detail: Improved scroll containment, quiet idle scrollbars, viewport-safe authority hover previews, source-format rendering, linked-case context, and live About statistics.

2026-09-01.detail: Reviewed active paths, repaired court abbreviation filtering, metadata-pass compatibility, docket extraction, and citation-rebuild alias handling; recorded remaining stale-test expectations.

2026-09-01.detail: Created the canonical system handbook, generated OpenAPI appendix, generated schema/ERD appendix, and this retained-session work ledger.
